reason: The plugin primarily provides a read-only directory listing tool and also enables session content search through a machine-local configuration layer.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读目录列表工具，并通过本地配置启用会话内容搜索。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with a read-only directory listing tool and enables session content search through local configuration.

capabilities: Lists directory child names, types, and sizes
Reads session filesystem metadata through the mounted filesystem provider
Enables durable session content search through local configuration
